name: Stocks
description: A watchlist of stocks, indexes, crypto and currencies: each price, its change since the previous close (an arrow, a sign and green or red) and a chart of the last month, from Yahoo Finance with no key (US stocks live, other markets 15 to 20 minutes late) or Twelve Data with a free key. Shows when markets are closed, updates every 15 minutes while they are open and hourly otherwise. One symbol, or a row tapped, is a big chart.
